limits: Inventory enumeration is static and read-only. It does not prove runtime behavior or business acceptance.
Explicit Fastify method registrations only; plugin-generated Swagger, Socket.IO transports and dynamic framework routes are separate surfaces.
Local auth, permission and validation call extraction is supporting evidence, not an authorization audit; inherited middleware and helper guards must be traced.
69 pgTable declarations do not include SQL-only deployment tables or pg-boss internal schema.
Test-file presence is not evidence that a test currently passes. Only explicitly dated execution records are partial developer evidence; QA-owned results remain independent.
Historical runtime evidence keeps its original pre-rebase source identifiers. This inventory uses the current rewritten release-01 commit and does not rewrite historical observations.
